preconditions.description: Both strings s and t are non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in s) and all(c.islower() for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist only of lowercase English letters.
The length of each string does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Yes' if all(any(s[j] == t[i] for i in range(len(t))) for j in range(len(s))) else return_value == 'No'
postconditions.description: Print 'Yes' if each character of string s occurs in at least one subsequence of s that coincides with string t, otherwise print 'No'.
